input: Set up a monthly one-on-one with my manager

gold.taskTitle: Set Up Monthly One-on-One With Your Manager
gold.taskDescription: Schedule a recurring monthly one-on-one meeting with the user's manager.

questions.title: Which calendar tool do you use for scheduling?
questions.description: Identify the platform (Google Calendar, Outlook, etc.) to be used for creating the recurring meeting.

questions.title: How long should each one-on-one session be?
questions.description: Determine the intended duration of each meeting (e.g., 30 minutes, 1 hour).

questions.title: Which day of the month works best for you?
questions.description: Pinpoint a preferred day pattern, such as the first Monday or last Friday of each month.

questions.title: What time of day do you prefer for this meeting?
questions.description: Capture the preferred time slot (morning, afternoon, a specific hour) for the recurring session.

questions.title: Are you proposing this or does your manager already know?
questions.description: Understand whether the user needs to initiate a conversation with the manager first or can proceed directly to scheduling.

questions.title: Will you send the invite or should your manager?
questions.description: Clarify who owns the calendar invite so the right action steps can be planned.

questions.title: Is there a specific agenda format you want prepared?
questions.description: Determine if the user wants a standing agenda, talking points template, or notes doc attached to each meeting.
